title: Chapter 2946 - 175: Deadly Vendetta
content:
Chapter 2946: Chapter 175: Deadly Vendetta

"His ’death moment’ was calculated by me using the flying sword Hua Book, personally reporting to Elder Ancestor across a vast distance, and asking Elder Ancestor to act on it..."

"Elder Ancestor also said, this is the only opportunity..."

"This person is deeply entwined with cause and effect, harboring disaster, cannot be seen, cannot be spied upon, cannot be stolen. In ordinary times, there are no flaws to be found."

"Only recently, he was engaged in a matter almost as crucial as ’life’, his heart spirit was completely preoccupied with himself, neglecting external defenses, which provided a slight opportunity for the Money Rat to follow the shallow cause and effect, determine his position, and gnaw at his Dao Body... At such a critical moment, to ruin his Dao and take his life, at worst would cause damage to his cultivation, causing his realm to stagnate..."

"But even so, he still... couldn’t be harmed?"

"Even the heavenly secret Money Rat died instantly and completely? Even the sculpture carved by the Money Rat shattered?"

"This person... could he really be the ’Divine Blessing’, with a deity residing within him?"

Elder You frowned deeply.

He is an elder of a Great Family of the Taoist Court, receiving the ’orthodox’ inheritance of the Taoist Court, and previously scoffed at matters of the Divine Way, thinking them to be mysterious forces and spirits, a pretense to delude and confuse people’s minds.

In Qianxue State Boundary, he joined the Demon Sect, pretending to ’believe in evil gods’ just for ’doing business’.

As long as there was profit and Spirit Stones to earn, he would believe anything.

But since entering the Great Wilderness, having witnessed various occurrences around him, he couldn’t help but have some doubts.

People cannot understand things they haven’t experienced.

But once they experience them, they can understand.

This so-called ’Divine Blessing’, merely at the Foundation Establishment Realm, if truly without the protection of a ’deity’, it would be impossible to accomplish such feats in the Barbaric Wilderness.

Even less likely, under Elder Ancestor’s cause and effect calculations and the fortune theft by the Money Rat, to remain intact.

"This ’Divine Blessing’ lord, one truly cannot judge a book by its cover, is indeed a truly terrifying character..."

"It’s just that..."

Elder You always feels that this ’Divine Blessing’ lord exudes a mysteriously familiar aura.

Moreover, his appearance and demeanor do not resemble the barbarians here in the ’Great Wilderness’, rather more like a foreigner.

This ’foreigner’, from where does he come?

From which state among Qian, Kun, Kan, Li, Gen, Zhen, Xun, Dui eight states, or Daoist State, does he originate?

Surely he didn’t fall from the sky?

Elder You also specifically investigated, but in the Barbaric Wilderness, no clues can be found.

He even asked Elder Ancestor to calculate but Elder Ancestor at first glance said "cannot be calculated", urging him to abandon this thought.

"For this Barbaric God Lord, his ’current’ cause and effect, including his current position, life and death, murder, fortune and disaster, even some future destiny can be calculated..."

"But solely cannot calculate ’past’ — at least not seeking within cause and effect."

"This is a whirlpool of great terror, absolutely cannot be touched."

"Touching it will cause great disaster..."

These were Elder Ancestor’s words.

This is also the first time Elder You heard Elder Ancestor evaluate a ’person’ in this manner over many years.

Yet merely a Foundation Establishment.

To the point that Elder You briefly thought he misheard.

If Elder Ancestor wasn’t typically serious and would never joke, he would think Elder Ancestor was teasing him.

From this, it’s clear, this ’Divine Blessing Lord’ is indeed a rather ’troublesome’ character, also absolutely impossible to ignore.

What’s more, what this ’Divine Blessing Lord’ is doing now, his intentions, already amount to committing a massive taboo.

Not only offending the Royal Court’s taboos but also the Taoist Court’s taboos.

Not only damaging tribal traditions but infringing upon the interests of aristocratic families.

Especially greatly disrupting the Hua family’s business.

He seeks unity in the Great Wilderness, how can our Hua family maintain ’division’?

He is equalizing resources in the Great Wilderness, how can our Hua family engage in ’exploitation’?

He is liberating barbarian slaves in the Great Wilderness, how can our Hua family buy and sell slaves?

...

Each of these things is entangled with vast wealth and interests, a ’blood sea vendetta’.

Elder You’s eyes flickered with a cold and venomous light.

"No matter what kind of godly being you, Divine Blessing, might be, those who disrupt my business must die!"

...

Meanwhile, Mo Hua also resolved his decision.

He wants to nourish his Life Formation, feed the Twelve Scripture Taotie Spirit Corpse Formation to fullness, he must find ways to obtain a large amount of Spirit Stones.

These Spirit Stones can only be taken from the ’Hua family’.

He wants the Hua family to assist him in Core Formation.

From this point onward, Mo Hua, under the name of Divine Blessing, ordered the Vermilion Bird Mountain’s barbarian soldiers and the Divine Slave Tribe’s barbarian slaves to continue advancing in divisional lines, to continue conquering the many Barbaric Mountain Realms not yet unified.

At the same time, he secretly commanded Lugu to clear out and suppress the Hua family’s forces parasitizing these Mountain Realms.

The Hua family is a ’parasite’, acting only for selfish gain.

Their methods are extremely covert, almost undetectable on the surface. But many matters in the shadows are pushed by the Hua family from behind.

Those who deal in major trades prefer ’chaos’ the most.

Only during great turmoil can one seek enormous profits, can one thrive.

Many tribes have headed towards division and destruction, propelled by the Hua family.

The chaos in the Barbaric Wilderness, the Hua family is also a supporter.

And the influence of the Hua family in the Great Wilderness is intertwined, deeply rooted.

Like a blood-sucking toxic vine, clinging to the big trees of the Barbaric Wilderness, under the guise of ’transaction’, continuously sucking the blood of the barbarian cultivators.

Besides Mo Hua indeed urgently needing ’Spirit Stones’, the Hua family of today is also one of his greatest ’enemies’ in promoting the unity of the Barbaric Wilderness.
